market_name: Will China invade Taiwan by end of 2026?

time_plan.30m: Check whether EWT/TSM are gapping and whether the probability spike coincides with any wire headlines (PLA movements, Taiwan mobilization). Distinguish real news from thin-market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare EWT move vs TSM ADR and USD/TWD; confirm cross-asset corroboration of the risk-off signal rather than an idiosyncratic ETF print.
time_plan.2h: Check VIX, gold, and Treasury futures for a broad flight-to-safety pattern consistent with a genuine geopolitical shock.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether the Polymarket probability has held its higher level or mean-reverted; a reversal implies noise and the equity thesis weakens.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate full-window EWT return vs prediction, note whether escalation was confirmed by credible reporting or faded, and log calibration.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp upward move in the implied probability of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan is the single most direct threat to Taiwanese assets. EWT is the most liquid, broadly-traded proxy for Taiwan-listed equity and would sell off hard on any credible escalation because an invasion would devastate the island's economy, disrupt TSMC-centric supply chains, and trigger capital flight. If the market moved enough to be a genuine signal (not noise), a >700bps drop is plausible given how binary and catastrophic the tail is.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm gold is bid alongside the probability move and check DXY for concurrent USD safe-haven flows.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check with Treasury yields falling and JPY strengthening to validate a genuine risk-off regime.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether gold's move is proportional to the equity risk-off or lagging/muted, indicating a weak proxy.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate if probability holds; fading odds should see gold give back gains.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized GLD return to forecast and note whether safe-haven flows materialized.

predictions.reasoning: A credible jump in Taiwan-invasion odds would drive classic safe-haven demand. Gold typically rises on major geopolitical tail risk. It is a weaker/slower proxy than direct Taiwan equity, so magnitude is smaller and may not clear the 700bps tradable bar unless the shock is severe, hence lower confidence and a wide interval skewed to the upside.

evidence_used: Market question implies a binary catastrophic geopolitical tail (Chinese military offensive against Taiwan)
Taiwan equity (EWT) and TSMC are the most directly exposed liquid assets to a Taiwan invasion scenario
Historical pattern of risk-off flows into gold, USD, JPY and Treasuries during major geopolitical shocks
Semiconductor supply-chain concentration in Taiwan amplifies global equity sensitivity
uncertainty_notes: Baseline probability of invasion is very low; most probability moves in this market are noise or thin liquidity rather than genuine information
A sharp move may already reflect public headlines, meaning the asset reaction is contemporaneous, not leaked
The prediction market could move without any real-world escalation, producing no asset move
Magnitude depends heavily on severity; a modest probability uptick may not move EWT 700bps

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability that China invades Taiwan would most directly and severely hit Taiwan equity proxies (EWT/TSM), which would sell off on war fears and supply-chain disruption, while driving safe-haven flows into gold, USD, JPY and Treasuries. The equity leg is the strongest, most liquid mapping; the gold leg is a weaker, slower hedge. Both are conditional on the probability move reflecting genuine escalation rather than thin-market noise.
key_assumptions: The probability move is large and genuine, not microstructure noise
No prior full public confirmation has already priced the shock into equities
EWT remains a faithful liquid proxy for Taiwan equity risk during the window
failure_modes: The probability spike is thin-market noise and reverses within hours, leaving assets unmoved
The escalation is already fully public, so equities have already repriced before the signal
A modest probability increase produces a sub-700bps equity move, failing the tradable threshold
Gold is a weak/lagging proxy and may not respond proportionally, or could fall if USD strength dominates
Broad market conditions (Fed, macro data) overwhelm the geopolitical signal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
